title: 第四章 、欢乐消消乐，大变活人
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

富贵震烨说话太毒了，端木棠梨都注意到温书琴变得姹紫嫣红的脸，担心她不会硬生生气晕过去。

“漂亮小姐姐，明天我会过来一趟，你要是考虑好要和我合作，可以跟我说。”

作为首富家独苗苗富贵震烨是有自己专属包间，之所以没回去，纯粹是不确定这次里世界覆盖面积有多大。

刚才保镖回来汇报包厢没错，东西一样不少都在包厢，富贵震烨无法忍受跟众人一起待着，那会让他回忆起以往难堪的经历，空气中难闻的酸臭、血腥味，告别端木棠梨，前往自己的包间。

他宁愿独自面临死亡危险，也不愿意回到过去那无能为力，任人宰割的情况。

端木棠梨目送富贵震烨，心里一阵阵恐慌。

富贵震烨身边的保镖出去后，又回来，富贵震烨说会再次过来，说明这次里世界覆盖整架列车。

站台上，端木棠梨就关注到G102号列车很大，幽灵列车同步G102号列车，地盘也不会小。

活动空间太大，危险指数跟着上涨。

根据那道阴森诡谲的声音提示，要么完成任务，要么征服里世界。

前者更容易完成，只是这个里世界会一直存在，会有更多人死在这里。

后者很难完成，别看如今危险不大，只是死了一个不听劝的蠢货，可这只是外区，里世界最安全的地方。

想要打破里世界，就要去核心区，本世界中最危险的地方。

端木棠梨预感给大伙时间不多，如果没人能想出解决办法，会直面这个世界最危险的存在。

她头一次希望自己敏锐的直觉是错误的，否则这次死亡人数将多得无可计量。

“欢乐消消乐即将到站，想要下车的乘客，请提前按铃。”

突然列车声音再次响起，端木棠梨按捺下内心的惶恐不安，阻止小姐妹按铃，让其他人先行踩雷。

在涉及自己人性命和其他人性命情况下，端木棠梨会优先选择护着自己人，眼神戒备看着其他按了铃的乘客，担心他们会突然暴走伤到自己人。

端木棠梨身边人很听她的话，说没按就没按，其他人不一样。

在倒霉男人被一个看似温和的幽灵给吞了，气氛变得压抑，恐惧在人心里蔓延，那些担子小的人撑不住这种压力，在听到列车说的话，立即疯狂按响自己身边的红色按钮，恨不得立即下车。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fugui Zhenye spoke so venomously that Duanmu Tangli even noticed Wen Shuqin's face turning bright red and worried that she would not faint from anger.

"Pretty lady, I will come over tomorrow. If you have considered cooperating with me, you can tell me."

As the richest man in the family, Miao Miao Fugui Zhenye has his own private room. The reason why he didn't go back was simply because he was not sure how big the world would be this time.

Just now the bodyguard came back and reported that the box was correct, and there were a lot of things in the box. Fugui Zhenye couldn't bear to stay with everyone. It would remind him of the embarrassing experiences in the past, the unpleasant sour smell and the smell of blood in the air. He bid farewell to Duanmu Tangli and went to his own box.

He would rather face the danger of death alone than go back to the past situation of being powerless and at the mercy of others.

Duanmu Tangli watched Fugui Zhenye, feeling panic in her heart.

The bodyguard around Fugui Zhenye went out and came back. Fugui Zhenye said he would come again, indicating that this time the world covered the entire train.

On the platform, Duanmu Tangli noticed that the G102 train was very big. The ghost train was synchronized with the G102 train and its territory would not be small.

There is too much room for movement, and the risk index rises accordingly.

According to the eerie voice prompts, you can either complete the mission or conquer the other world.

The former is easier to complete, but this world will always exist and more people will die here.

The latter is difficult to complete. Even though the danger is not great now, just a fool who did not listen to advice died, but this is only the outer area, the safest place in the inner world.

If you want to break into the other world, you have to go to the core area, the most dangerous place in this world.

Duanmu Tangli had a hunch that there was not much time left for everyone. If no one could come up with a solution, they would face the most dangerous existence in the world.

For the first time, she hoped that her keen intuition was wrong, otherwise the death toll would be unfathomable.

"Happy Fun is about to arrive at the station. Passengers who want to get off please ring the bell in advance."

Suddenly the sound of the train rang again. Duanmu Tangli suppressed the panic in his heart and stopped the little sisters from ringing the bell, letting others step on the thunder first.

In situations where his own life and the lives of others are involved, Duanmu Tangli will give priority to protecting his own people and look warily at other passengers who have rang the bell, fearing that they may suddenly go berserk and hurt his own people.

The people around Duanmu Tangli listened to her words very much and didn't press her words if they didn't. Others were different.

After the unlucky man was swallowed by a seemingly gentle ghost, the atmosphere became depressing, and fear spread in people's hearts. Those with a small burden could not bear the pressure. When they heard what the train said, they immediately pressed the red button beside them frantically, eager to get off the train immediately.
